title: Gypsy
headline: Gypsy
about: is a location based photo sharing app designed for travel bloggers, archaeologists, history buffs, photographers, and avid travellers. The app not only allows you to store and share your travel pictures, memories, and discoveries with the rest of the world but also goes a few steps beyond.

blocks.heading: Challenges
blocks.lead: The main challenging task was to enable user to mark 3×3 square meter grids. This 3×3 meter grids will have unique code which can work as identification of GPS co-ordinates and can be shared with fellow traveller.
blocks.body: This help user to know view post around user GPS location and like, share and comment.

blocks.heading: Core Features
blocks.lead: Travellers like to explore a place’s culture, some others like to dive deeper into the history, while others might want to explore the food and shopping scene of a particular place.
blocks.body: Some of the best snapshots are taken in places less seen and unheard of. Now you can lock in these amazing vista points using 3×3 square meter grids and share it with fellow travellers. These grids also act as excellent landmarks when you want to explore the exact location of places of historical importance.

blocks.heading: Solutions
blocks.lead: provided the best-in-class location based photo sharing app solutions for user to share stories with in 3 steps and mark there current 3×3 grid right on app with all our top-of-the-line Pythons developers.

## Build a community and discover the world in a way you’ve never done before

What kind of social networking app would Gypsy be without sharing your travel memories, experiences, anecdotes, and tips. Connect with fellow travellers (Gypsies) and adorn your feed with a lifetime’s worth of travel photos and stories.
